tasks.title: Доска: резервные копии
tasks.statement: Соберите защиту виртуальных машин на доске: у каждой машины должна быть копия, которая переживёт потерю домена с её диском. Пять сценариев: снимки, которые не являются копиями, тип копии под тип диска, машины второго домена, забытая машина и новая машина без диска и копии. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Снимок лежит на том же домене, что и диск, и погибает вместе с ним. Спасает только инкрементальная или полная копия. Инкрементальная требует диска qcow2 с отслеживанием изменений, сырой диск копируют целиком.

scenarios.title: Snapshots are not backups
scenarios.story: Every night all three VMs get a snapshot, and the audit still fails the setup: when nfs-data is lost, the snapshots are lost with it.
scenarios.goal: Every VM has a copy that survives the loss of its disk domain
scenarios.hint: A snapshot lives on the same storage domain as the disk it was taken from. Look at the type of the backup.

scenarios.title: Full or incremental
scenarios.story: db-1 keeps its data on a raw disk, while app-1, app-2 and mail-1 use qcow2 disks. Two of the three backup jobs still make snapshots, which do not survive the loss of nfs-data.
scenarios.goal: Every VM is backed up off its domain: the raw disk with full copies, the qcow2 disks incrementally
scenarios.hint: Incremental backup tracks changed blocks in a qcow2 disk, so a raw disk can only be copied whole. Set the type of each job to match its disks.

scenarios.title: Two domains, two backup jobs
scenarios.story: web-nightly protects web-1 and web-2 on nfs-a. db-1 and db-2 live on nfs-b and have no backup at all, and every group of VMs is supposed to have a job of its own.
scenarios.goal: Every VM is backed up off its domain, with a separate job for the databases
scenarios.hint: A new backup job starts as a snapshot. Check that the VMs of each domain are covered by a job that survives losing that domain.

scenarios.title: The VM nobody backed up
scenarios.story: The audit counted eight VMs and only seven are covered by a backup job. Nobody remembers which one was left out.
scenarios.goal: All eight VMs are backed up off their domain
scenarios.hint: Follow the backup links of every VM. A VM that was added later than the others is the usual suspect.

scenarios.title: The VM created last week
scenarios.story: report-1 was created last week on host-2 and nobody finished it: it has no disk and no backup.
scenarios.goal: report-1 has a disk on nfs-data, and every VM is backed up off its domain
scenarios.hint: Compare report-1 with the other VMs: it is missing everything they have. Once it has a disk, the backup has to cover it as well.

tasks.title: Доска: аварийное восстановление
tasks.statement: Постройте на доске аварийное восстановление между дата-центрами: реплика домена хранения должна жить в другом дата-центре и быть активной. Пять сценариев: первая реплика, реплика в дата-центре без хостов, две площадки, реплицирующиеся друг в друга, машина с дисками на двух доменах и копия, лежащая рядом с оригиналом. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Площадку переживает только реплика в другом дата-центре, и только активная: домен Active, когда его видит хост Up своего дата-центра. Покрыть нужно каждый домен с дисками машины, а у реплики один основной домен.

scenarios.title: A copy in the other data center
scenarios.story: All production VMs keep their disks on nfs-prod in the Default data center. The Recovery data center has a host and nothing else, and losing the Default site would lose every disk.
scenarios.goal: Every VM disk has a replica that is Active in the Recovery data center, and both data centers are Up
scenarios.hint: A replica is a storage domain of its own in the other data center. The hosts there must see it, or it stays Inactive.

scenarios.title: A replica nobody can open
scenarios.story: nfs-dr is configured as the replica of nfs-prod and attached to the Recovery data center, but the drill shows it Inactive and the Recovery data center is not Up.
scenarios.goal: The replica is Active in an Up Recovery data center, so the production disks survive the loss of the Default site
scenarios.hint: A domain is Active only while an Up host of its data center sees it. Look at what the Recovery data center has.

scenarios.title: Two sites, each other's backup
scenarios.story: East and West both run production VMs, and each site has a spare domain waiting for the copy of the other site's data. Nothing is replicated yet.
scenarios.goal: Losing either site loses no VM disk: each production domain is replicated into the other data center
scenarios.hint: A copy in the same data center does not survive the loss of that data center. Pair every production domain with the spare of the other site.

scenarios.title: One disk of two
scenarios.story: db-1 has disks on nfs-os and nfs-data. After the drill the Recovery site brought back its system disk but not the data disk.
scenarios.goal: Every disk domain of every VM has its own replica in the Recovery data center
scenarios.hint: Check each disk domain of db-1 for a copy in the other site. A copy belongs to one primary only.

scenarios.title: The copy sits next to the original
scenarios.story: nfs-copy is the replica of nfs-prod, but both domains are attached to the Default data center. The Recovery data center runs on its own nfs-local and has no copy of production.
scenarios.goal: The replica of nfs-prod is Active in the Recovery data center and both data centers are Up
scenarios.hint: A domain is attached to one data center. A copy in the same site disappears together with the original, so it has to be moved.
